bagPolicy.summary: Only handbags or very small bags up to 35 × 40 × 19 cm are allowed, with no on-site bag storage. Arrange a medical-bag exception in advance.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: The arena provides a separate car-parking guide for nearby paid parking options.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The arena safety and car-parking pages do not give a designated rideshare pickup point.

concessions.summary: The arena sells food and drinks through its own concessions. The security guidance does not publish a general outside-food allowance.
